source.name: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D
source.modifications: Selected named meshes; evaluated existing source modifiers; applied world transforms; rotated axes, converted metres to millimetres and centered the skull; assigned display colours; exported GLB. No remeshing, decimation or smoothing.

groups.name: Cranial bones
groups.description: 8 bones · brain case and cranial base

groups.name: Facial bones
groups.description: 14 bones · face, palate and nasal cavity

groups.name: Auditory ossicles
groups.description: 6 bones · three in each middle ear

groups.name: Teeth
groups.description: 28 teeth · third molars absent from this atlas

structures.name: Frontal bone
structures.description: Forms the forehead, roofs of the orbits and the anterior cranial floor.

structures.name: Left parietal bone
structures.description: Forms the upper lateral wall and roof of the cranial vault.

structures.name: Right parietal bone
structures.description: Forms the upper lateral wall and roof of the cranial vault.

structures.name: Left temporal bone
structures.description: Forms part of the lateral skull and cranial base. Its petrous part surrounds the middle and inner ear.

structures.name: Right temporal bone
structures.description: Forms part of the lateral skull and cranial base. Its petrous part surrounds the middle and inner ear.

structures.name: Occipital bone
structures.description: Forms the back and lower part of the cranium and surrounds the foramen magnum.

structures.name: Sphenoid bone
structures.description: Spans the central cranial base. Its wings contribute to the orbits and the sides of the skull.

structures.name: Ethmoid bone
structures.description: Lies between the orbits. Contributes to the nasal septum, nasal cavity and anterior cranial floor.

structures.name: Left maxilla
structures.description: Forms the upper jaw and part of the hard palate, nasal cavity and orbital floor. Supports the upper teeth.

structures.name: Right maxilla
structures.description: Forms the upper jaw and part of the hard palate, nasal cavity and orbital floor. Supports the upper teeth.

structures.name: Left zygomatic bone
structures.description: Forms the prominence of the cheek and contributes to the lateral orbital wall and zygomatic arch.

structures.name: Right zygomatic bone
structures.description: Forms the prominence of the cheek and contributes to the lateral orbital wall and zygomatic arch.

structures.name: Left nasal bone
structures.description: Forms the bony bridge of the nose.

structures.name: Right nasal bone
structures.description: Forms the bony bridge of the nose.

structures.name: Left lacrimal bone
structures.description: Small bone in the medial orbital wall, beside the groove for the lacrimal sac.

structures.name: Right lacrimal bone
structures.description: Small bone in the medial orbital wall, beside the groove for the lacrimal sac.

structures.name: Left palatine bone
structures.description: Forms the posterior hard palate and contributes to the nasal cavity and a small part of the orbit.

structures.name: Right palatine bone
structures.description: Forms the posterior hard palate and contributes to the nasal cavity and a small part of the orbit.

structures.name: Left inferior nasal concha
structures.description: A separate curled bone on the lateral wall of the nasal cavity. The middle and superior conchae belong to the ethmoid.

structures.name: Right inferior nasal concha
structures.description: A separate curled bone on the lateral wall of the nasal cavity. The middle and superior conchae belong to the ethmoid.

structures.name: Vomer
structures.description: Forms the lower and posterior part of the bony nasal septum.

structures.name: Mandible
structures.description: Forms the lower jaw and supports the lower teeth. Its condyles articulate with the temporal bones.

structures.name: Left malleus
structures.description: The hammer-shaped middle-ear ossicle. Its handle attaches to the tympanic membrane and its head articulates with the incus.

structures.name: Right malleus
structures.description: The hammer-shaped middle-ear ossicle. Its handle attaches to the tympanic membrane and its head articulates with the incus.

structures.name: Left incus
structures.description: The anvil-shaped middle-ear ossicle between the malleus and stapes.

structures.name: Right incus
structures.description: The anvil-shaped middle-ear ossicle between the malleus and stapes.

structures.name: Left stapes
structures.description: The stirrup-shaped middle-ear ossicle. Its footplate transmits vibration to the oval window.

structures.name: Right stapes
structures.description: The stirrup-shaped middle-ear ossicle. Its footplate transmits vibration to the oval window.

structures.name: Hyoid bone
structures.description: A separate bone below the mandible that supports the tongue and provides muscle attachments. It does not articulate directly with the skull.
